diagnosis_current_system_gaps.summary: The existing 5-shot rotation matrix (visual.md §4) and all 20 style camera_rotation_overrides default to 5 primary scales: Wide Establishing, Medium OTS, Tight Action Macro, Atmospheric Landscape, Low-Angle Hero. While varied on paper, they produce repetitive medium/wide front-facing character compositions because: (1) 'Tight Action Macro' at 85mm still frames the subject's upper body/face rather than zero-face prop inserts, (2) no OTS dirty-single with foreground obstruction generating spatial tension, (3) no ground-level boot/mud POV below knee height, (4) no high-angle God's-eye overhead formation geometry, (5) no micro-reaction eye/hand close-ups in extreme shallow DoF, (6) no environmental sensory B-roll without any human subject.
root_causes: All 5 camera slots include human subjects — zero dedicated prop-only or environment-only slots
Prompt Block 2 always specifies 'Primary Subject & Action' with a named human actor, which guides AI to center a person in every frame
Macro slot (85mm-100mm) says 'Hands stringing crossbow' but consistently generates a medium-tight shot including face + torso
No prompt vocabulary for overhead/bird's-eye perpendicular-down geometry
No prompt vocabulary for foreground-obstructed OTS compositions where we see THROUGH/PAST an object
No dedicated 'environment-only sensory beat' in any style's narrative_beat_roles
flow_stage.py only classifies beats as flow_video vs 2k_native_kenburns — no asset_mode distinction for insert-only micro beats

class_01_extreme_macro_tactile_prop_inse.description: Extreme macro close-up of a physical prop or action element with ZERO human face visible. The subject is a THING, not a person: a hand gripping a seal, ink dripping onto parchment, mud squeezing through fingers around an ironwood stake, fire licking bamboo, rope fibers straining under tension, rain droplets hitting lacquered armor plates.
class_01_extreme_macro_tactile_prop_inse.composition_rule: Subject fills 60-80% of frame. Human skin (hand, fingers, forearm) may appear but face is NEVER in frame. Background is 100% bokeh blur.
class_01_extreme_macro_tactile_prop_inse.camera_move: ultra_slow_push_in (0.3cm/s drift), or static with rack_focus
reference_examples: Rise of Empires: candlelight reflecting on wet ink as treaty is signed (frame row 3)
Band of Brothers: muddy hand pulling grenade pin
The Last Kingdom: extreme close-up of sword being drawn from leather scabbard
class_01_extreme_macro_tactile_prop_inse.beluga_prompt_template: {period_prop} in extreme 100mm macro close-up, shallow depth of field, only the object and immediate tactile surface visible, NO human face, {lighting_key}, crisp fine detail of {material_texture}, natural film grain, 35mm Kodak Vision3 500T, no text, no captions, no watermarks
class_01_extreme_macro_tactile_prop_inse.veo_motion_template: Ultra-slow 0.3cm/s push-in toward {prop}, subtle {material_interaction} micro-movement, shallow rack focus drift, steady macro tracking
su_ke_lai_examples: Ironwood stake tip being sharpened, curling wood shavings falling, muddy calloused fingers gripping the charred wood
Cinnabar seal pressing into hot wax on a bamboo-paper imperial edict, red wax spreading under pressure
Bronze crossbow trigger mechanism being loaded, iron bolt clicking into bamboo groove
Torch flame igniting pitch-soaked fire raft ropes, sparks scattering across wet river mud
Rain streaming down lacquered iron lamellar armor plates, droplets pooling in plate valleys

class_02_ots_dirty_single.description: Over-the-shoulder shot where camera is positioned behind one character, showing them partially in soft-focus foreground (shoulder, ear, hair, helmet edge) while the second character or scene unfolds in sharp focus beyond. Creates spatial tension, psychological weight, and shot/reverse-shot readiness.
class_02_ots_dirty_single.composition_rule: Foreground character occupies 25-35% of frame edge (shoulder/head in soft blur). Background subject/scene in sharp focus occupies center-right 65-75%. Foreground shoulder creates a natural dark vignette on one edge.
class_02_ots_dirty_single.camera_move: static or very slow truck_lateral (1cm/s), occasionally slow push_in past foreground shoulder
reference_examples: Rise of Empires: Mehmed in foreground blur watching Constantinople walls (frame row 2, col 3-4)
Saving Private Ryan: OTS past helmet watching beach assault
Game of Thrones: OTS past Tyrion's shoulder watching Jon Snow
class_02_ots_dirty_single.beluga_prompt_template: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind {foreground_character}'s {body_part_visible} in soft bokeh foreground, sharp focus on {background_subject} in the middle distance, {lighting_key}, 50mm-85mm cinema lens, 35mm Kodak Vision3 500T film, spatial depth tension, {environment_detail}, no text, no captions
class_02_ots_dirty_single.veo_motion_template: Slow push-in past {foreground_character}'s shoulder, drifting focus toward {background_subject}, subtle foreground parallax separation
su_ke_lai_examples: OTS past Lý Thường Kiệt's armored shoulder watching Song war junks approaching on the river at dawn
OTS past a scout's bamboo hat watching enemy torchlight procession through mountain pass at night
OTS past a kneeling crossbow soldier's hemp-wrapped shoulder aiming across rain-swept estuary

class_03_ground_level_boots_in_mud.description: Camera positioned at ground level (0–30cm from mud/dirt/water surface), shooting upward or along the ground plane. Boots, hooves, oar tips, and terrain texture dominate the foreground with subjects towering above. Creates visceral scale, immersion in physical conditions, and a soldier's-eye perspective of approaching threat.
class_03_ground_level_boots_in_mud.lens_spec: 24mm–28mm ultra-wide, f/4.0–f/5.6, deep focus from 30cm to infinity
class_03_ground_level_boots_in_mud.composition_rule: Camera at ankle height. Foreground is 40% mud/water/terrain texture. Middle-ground shows boots/hooves/stakes. Background shows towering figures, sky, or approaching army silhouettes. Strong perspective exaggeration.
class_03_ground_level_boots_in_mud.camera_move: low_tracking_alongside (following marching boots), or static with figures walking OVER camera
reference_examples: Yarnhub D-Day: ground-level explosion impact spraying debris toward camera (frame row 1, col 1-2)
Gladiator: sandal-level tracking through Colosseum tunnel
class_03_ground_level_boots_in_mud.beluga_prompt_template: Ground-level 24mm ultra-wide shot at ankle height, camera pressed into {terrain_surface}, {foreground_element} dominates lower 40% of frame, {background_subject} towering above against {sky_condition}, deep-focus cinematic depth, 35mm Kodak Vision3 500T, dramatic perspective exaggeration, no text, no captions
class_03_ground_level_boots_in_mud.veo_motion_template: Low ground-level tracking alongside {movement_subject}, mud/water splashing near lens, parallax between terrain foreground and towering background figures
su_ke_lai_examples: Ground-level through Red River Delta mud, iron-tipped ironwood stakes protruding upward, distant Song war junks silhouetted against dawn sky
Ankle-height behind marching Đại Việt infantry boots in monsoon mud, puddles reflecting torchlight
Ground-level along river bank, oar tips slicing dark water in foreground, flat-bottomed war galley hull towering above

class_04_high_angle_gods_eye.description: Direct overhead (70°–90° perpendicular-down) shot showing formation geometry, terrain layout, and spatial relationships from a bird's-eye / God's-eye perspective. Removes horizon line entirely. Subjects appear as geometric patterns against terrain texture.
class_04_high_angle_gods_eye.composition_rule: No horizon visible. Ground fills 100% of frame. Subjects seen from directly above as geometric formations or solitary figures against terrain canvas. Strong geometric patterns (circles, lines, triangles of troop formations).
class_04_high_angle_gods_eye.camera_move: slow_crane_descend or static_overhead, occasionally slow_orbit around center point
reference_examples: Rise of Empires: God's-eye Constantinople fortification layout (frame row 4, col 1)
Lord of the Rings: overhead Helm's Deep approach
Game of Thrones: overhead Battle of Winterfell troop geometry
class_04_high_angle_gods_eye.beluga_prompt_template: Bird's-eye perpendicular overhead shot looking straight down at {formation_or_scene}, {terrain_texture} fills entire frame, NO horizon visible, geometric {pattern_description}, {lighting_key}, deep-focus 35mm cinema lens, 35mm Kodak Vision3 500T, historical docudrama, no text, no captions
class_04_high_angle_gods_eye.veo_motion_template: Slow descending crane from high overhead, revealing geometric {formation_pattern}, gradual zoom toward tactical center point
su_ke_lai_examples: Overhead: ironwood stake field geometry in Bạch Đằng river bed at low tide, stakes forming defensive grid pattern
Overhead: Đại Việt infantry square formation from directly above, circular shield-wall against muddy terrain
Overhead: river battle from God's-eye, oar wakes forming V-patterns on dark water surface, burning fire rafts drifting downstream

class_05_reaction_micro_acting.description: Extreme close-up (ECU) of micro-facial reactions: eyes widening in torchlight, jaw clenching, bead of sweat rolling down temple, trembling exhale visible in cold air, hand clenching sword hilt until knuckles whiten. The subject IS the emotion, not the action.
class_05_reaction_micro_acting.lens_spec: 85mm–135mm, f/1.4–f/2.0, razor-thin DoF plane on eyes or hands
class_05_reaction_micro_acting.composition_rule: Face fills 80-100% of frame. Eyes occupy upper 1/3 rule line. Only eyes-to-chin visible (forehead may be cropped). Background is 100% warm/cold bokeh. Lighting creates catchlights in eyes.
class_05_reaction_micro_acting.camera_move: static or ultra_slow_push_in (barely perceptible drift toward eyes)
reference_examples: Rise of Empires: Mehmed's face in candlelight close-up showing determination (frame row 2, col 3-5)
Yarnhub: soldier's face micro-expressions before cliff assault (frame row 2, col 4-5)
Schindler's List: Amon Goeth's eye twitching in extreme close-up
class_05_reaction_micro_acting.beluga_prompt_template: Extreme close-up 135mm portrait of {character_description}'s {emotion_visible} expression, eyes filling upper third, {lighting_catchlight_detail}, razor-thin depth of field on the iris, warm {bokeh_color} bokeh background, {micro_detail}, 35mm Kodak Vision3 500T, intimate cinematic portrait, no text, no captions
class_05_reaction_micro_acting.veo_motion_template: Near-static frame with barely perceptible 0.2cm/s push toward {character}'s eyes, subtle {micro_movement} visible, breathing rhythm in chest/shoulders
su_ke_lai_examples: ECU: Commander's eyes reflecting torchlight as he receives the invasion report, jaw muscles tensing imperceptibly
ECU: Soldier's trembling exhale visible in pre-dawn cold air, pupils dilating as war drums begin
ECU: Weathered river pilot's eyes scanning the tide mark, sweat bead rolling down temple, hand grip tightening on tiller

class_06_environmental_sensory_broll.description: Pure environmental shot with ZERO human subjects. The environment IS the subject: rain drumming on terracotta roof tiles, river current swirling around submerged stakes, smoke curling from an abandoned campfire, wind rippling through a bamboo grove, dawn light crawling across a silent battlefield aftermath. Provides breathing room, temporal transition, and sensory texture between dialogue/action beats.
class_06_environmental_sensory_broll.lens_spec: 35mm–85mm, f/2.8–f/5.6, selective focus on environmental detail
class_06_environmental_sensory_broll.composition_rule: No human figure in frame. Environmental element fills 70-100% of composition. Movement comes from natural forces: water, wind, fire, light. Strong texture emphasis.
class_06_environmental_sensory_broll.camera_move: static_hold (3-5s), or slow_tilt_up revealing sky, or slow_tracking across surface
reference_examples: Rise of Empires: empty battlefield with fog and silhouette fortifications (frame row 1, col 1)
Yarnhub: dark cliff silhouette against pre-dawn sky (frame row 5, col 1-3)
Band of Brothers: rain on empty foxhole, slow tilt up to grey sky
class_06_environmental_sensory_broll.beluga_prompt_template: {environmental_element} in intimate detail, NO human figures visible, {natural_force} creates organic movement, {lighting_key}, {texture_emphasis}, contemplative atmosphere, 35mm Kodak Vision3 500T, historical docudrama environmental B-roll, no text, no captions
class_06_environmental_sensory_broll.veo_motion_template: Static hold with natural {element_movement}, {atmospheric_micro_detail}, slow organic rhythm, ambient environmental sound implied
su_ke_lai_examples: Rain streaming down curved terracotta roof tiles of Đại La citadel at night, droplets splashing in ceramic gutter
River current swirling around half-submerged ironwood stakes at sunrise, golden light refracting through dark water eddies
Smoke curling from dying embers of an abandoned campfire at dawn, bamboo chopsticks and an overturned rice bowl in the ashes
Wind rippling a weathered Đại Việt silk battle banner on a bamboo pole, frayed edges catching last light
Morning mist lifting from a still rice paddy surface, revealing a distant row of watchtower silhouettes

formula_A_tactical_command_sequence.name: Command Decision Sequence
formula_A_tactical_command_sequence.purpose: Cover a commander receiving intelligence and making a tactical decision

shot_sequence.desc: Overhead: troop/terrain layout establishing the problem
OTS past scout/messenger's shoulder to commander receiving report
ECU commander's eyes processing the intelligence
Extreme macro: commander's hand pressing seal onto deployment order / drawing sword

formula_B_ambush_eruption_sequence.name: Ambush Eruption Sequence
formula_B_ambush_eruption_sequence.purpose: Cover the moment before and during a surprise attack

shot_sequence.desc: Environmental: eerie calm — river surface, rustling bamboo, pre-dawn silence
Ground-level: boots/hooves suddenly breaking into motion
Macro: bowstring releasing / crossbow trigger snapping
ECU: enemy soldier's face registering shock / arrow impact
God's-eye: full ambush geometry revealed from above

formula_B_ambush_eruption_sequence.narrative_function: Establishing → Blocking → Tactile Insert → Consequence → Analytical Cut

formula_C_evidence_investigation_sequenc.name: Forensic Evidence Sequence
formula_C_evidence_investigation_sequenc.purpose: Cover the discovery and analysis of historical evidence/artifact

shot_sequence.desc: OTS past scholar's shoulder: approaching chronicle/artifact on evidence surface
Extreme macro: ink text on parchment, seal impression, bronze inscription detail
ECU: scholar's eyes widening as contradiction/discovery registers
Environmental: candle flame flickering, rain on archive roof — contemplative pause

formula_C_evidence_investigation_sequenc.narrative_function: Spatial Context → Tactile Evidence → Emotional Impact → Breathing Beat

formula_D_battle_impact_sequence.name: Battle Impact Sequence
formula_D_battle_impact_sequence.purpose: Cover the climactic moment of physical combat

shot_sequence.desc: Ground-level: charging feet, hooves, mud spray
OTS: defender's perspective of incoming charge
Macro: weapon impact — stake piercing hull, sword slicing bamboo shield
ECU: victorious/defeated combatant's face in aftermath
God's-eye: aftermath geometry — bodies, broken formations, burning ships

formula_D_battle_impact_sequence.narrative_function: Ground-Level Chaos → Spatial Tension → Tactile Impact → Human Cost → Strategic Consequence

formula_E_temporal_transition_sequence.name: Time-Passage Sensory Bridge
formula_E_temporal_transition_sequence.purpose: Cover the passage of time between narrative phases without narration

shot_sequence.desc: Environmental: sunset/sunrise/seasonal change on landscape
Macro: candle burning down / water level changing / rust forming on weapon
Environmental: new time period — different light, weather, or season

formula_E_temporal_transition_sequence.narrative_function: Breathing Beat → Physical Time Marker → New Temporal Context

formula_F_psychological_duel_sequence.name: Commander Psychological Duel
formula_F_psychological_duel_sequence.purpose: Cover two commanders' opposing decisions in rapid cross-cut

shot_sequence.desc: ECU Commander A: calculating expression, warm torchlight
Macro: Commander A's hand moving token/writing order
ECU Commander B: cold moonlight, different lighting temperature
Macro: Commander B's hand drawing sword / slamming table
OTS: one commander through the other's blur — psychological collision
God's-eye: their opposing army formations on the terrain between them

formula_F_psychological_duel_sequence.narrative_function: Intimate A → Tactile A → Counter B → Tactile B → Spatial Confrontation → Strategic Overview

expanded_camera_rotation_12_slot.description: Expanded 12-slot camera rotation matrix replacing the original 5-slot system. Rotate continuously so no two adjacent cuts share the same class code.

slots.function: Terrain geometry, troop formation patterns, strategic overview
Spatial tension, psychological weight, scene layering
Zero-face physical detail, tactile texture, action consequence
Emotional processing, decision weight, human cost
Physical immersion, scale exaggeration, threat approach
Tactical dialogue, troop coordination, spatial blocking
Breathing beat, temporal transition, atmospheric texture
Commander authority, standard-bearer, dramatic sky framing
Combat impact, weapon clash, physical struggle
Epic scale compression, army-against-sky, fortress profile

expanded_camera_rotation_12_slot.rotation_rule: Never repeat the same class code in adjacent beats. Minimum 3 different class codes in any 5-consecutive-beat window. MACRO_PROP and ENV_SENSORY must each appear at least once per 8-beat sequence.

MACRO_PROP_templates.weapon_mechanism: Extreme 100mm macro close-up of {weapon_mechanism}, only iron/bronze/wood mechanism visible, NO human face, calloused fingers {interaction_verb} in lower frame edge, shallow f/2.0 depth of field, {lighting_key}, crisp metallurgical surface detail, natural film grain, {film_lock}
MACRO_PROP_templates.document_artifact: Extreme 100mm macro close-up of {document_type} on {surface}, brush ink / cinnabar seal detail visible at thread level, NO human face, weathered fingertip touching {specific_detail} at frame edge, candlelight catchlight on wet ink, {film_lock}
MACRO_PROP_templates.environmental_prop: Extreme 85mm macro close-up of {environmental_element}, {material_texture} fills 80% of frame, {natural_force} creating micro-movement, NO human subject, {lighting_key}, {film_lock}
MACRO_PROP_templates.consequence_impact: Extreme 100mm macro close-up of {impact_result}, {material_deformation} visible at grain level, {debris_or_liquid} in motion, shallow depth of field, {lighting_key}, {film_lock}

OTS_DIRTY_templates.command_tension: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind {foreground_char}'s {armor_detail} shoulder in soft bokeh, sharp focus on {background_scene} beyond, 50mm cinema lens, two-plane depth separation, {lighting_key}, spatial command tension, {film_lock}
OTS_DIRTY_templates.threat_approach: Dirty single past {foreground_char}'s weathered {headgear} in dark foreground blur, sharp focus on approaching {threat_description} in middle distance, 85mm lens, {lighting_key}, {film_lock}
OTS_DIRTY_templates.witness_pov: Over-the-shoulder past {witness_char}'s hemp-clad shoulder, sharp focus on {event_unfolding} in the courtyard/river beyond, 50mm natural perspective, {lighting_key}, {film_lock}

GROUND_MUD_templates.march_tracking: Ground-level 24mm ultra-wide shot at ankle height, camera pressed into {terrain}, muddy {footwear_type} marching through lower 40% of frame, {background_formation} towering above against {sky}, deep-focus perspective exaggeration, {film_lock}
GROUND_MUD_templates.river_surface: Water-level 24mm shot barely above {river_name} surface, oar blades cutting dark water in extreme foreground, {vessel_type} hull towering above, {sky_condition}, {film_lock}
GROUND_MUD_templates.aftermath_ground: Ground-level 28mm shot through battlefield debris, broken {weapons_shields} in extreme foreground, {aftermath_scene} in background, {lighting_key}, {film_lock}

GODS_EYE_templates.formation_geometry: Bird's-eye perpendicular overhead shot looking straight down at {formation_type} on {terrain_texture}, NO horizon visible, geometric {pattern} of troops/stakes/ships, {lighting_key}, deep-focus 35mm cinema lens, {film_lock}
GODS_EYE_templates.river_tactical: God's-eye perpendicular-down shot of {river_name} estuary, stake field / ship positions visible as geometric patterns on dark water, {lighting_key}, topographic military geography, {film_lock}
GODS_EYE_templates.aftermath_overhead: Bird's-eye overhead shot of {aftermath_scene}, fallen combatants forming {pattern} on {terrain}, burning {debris} creating smoke trails visible from above, {film_lock}

REACTION_MICRO_templates.decision_weight: Extreme close-up 135mm portrait filling frame with {character}'s face from forehead to chin, {emotion} visible in eyes, {lighting_catchlight} creating iris catchlights, razor-thin depth of field, warm {bokeh_color} bokeh, {micro_detail}, {film_lock}
REACTION_MICRO_templates.shock_register: Extreme close-up of {character}'s widening eyes, pupils dilating, {physical_micro_reaction}, {lighting_key} casting sharp shadow across bridge of nose, 135mm f/1.4, {film_lock}
REACTION_MICRO_templates.resolve_harden: Extreme close-up of {character}'s jaw clenching, lips pressing together, {hand_detail} tightening on {object}, {lighting_key}, 100mm f/2.0, {film_lock}

ENV_SENSORY_templates.weather_texture: {weather_element} on {architectural_surface}, NO human figures, {natural_movement} creating organic rhythm, {lighting_key}, contemplative atmosphere, 50mm selective focus on texture, {film_lock}
ENV_SENSORY_templates.water_current: {water_body} current detail, {submerged_elements} partially visible, NO human subject, {light_on_water}, slow organic movement, 85mm selective focus, {film_lock}
ENV_SENSORY_templates.fire_smoke: {fire_source} in final stages, {smoke_behavior}, {debris_in_ash}, NO human figures, {time_of_day} lighting, contemplative post-action atmosphere, {film_lock}
ENV_SENSORY_templates.dawn_dusk_passage: {sky_condition} at {time}, {landscape_silhouette} visible against {light_direction}, NO human figures, environmental time-passage marker, {film_lock}

short_9x16_coverage_budget.coverage_rule: Every 20-beat Short MUST include >=2 MACRO_PROP, >=1 OTS_DIRTY, >=1 GROUND_MUD or GODS_EYE, >=1 REACTION_MICRO, >=1 ENV_SENSORY. At least 30% of beats must be non-human-centered (MACRO_PROP + ENV_SENSORY + GODS_EYE).

long_16x9_coverage_budget.coverage_rule: Every Long episode MUST include >=15% MACRO_PROP beats, >=8% OTS_DIRTY beats, >=5% GROUND_MUD+GODS_EYE beats, >=8% REACTION_MICRO beats, >=6% ENV_SENSORY beats. No chapter may have zero instances of any missing shot class.

OTS_DIRTY.motion_type: push_in past foreground shoulder or slow truck_lateral

OTS_DIRTY.prompt_suffix: , slow push-in past foreground shoulder, foreground-background parallax depth, steady cinematic tracking

GROUND_MUD.terrain_interaction: Required: mud splashing, water rippling, debris shifting near lens
GROUND_MUD.prompt_suffix: , ground-level tracking alongside marching boots, terrain particles near lens, strong low-angle perspective

GODS_EYE.geometric_emphasis: Required: formations must read as geometric patterns from above
GODS_EYE.prompt_suffix: , slow descending crane from overhead, geometric formation patterns visible, perpendicular-down perspective

REACTION_MICRO.breathing_motion: Required: subject's chest/shoulder breathing movement visible
REACTION_MICRO.prompt_suffix: , near-static frame with barely perceptible drift toward eyes, subject breathing rhythm visible, intimate cinematic portrait

macaron_cookie_omni_frame_link_guidance.description: For Long 16x9 2-Frame Continuous Chains using macaron_cookie Omni 1.2 Flash Frame-Link

coverage_chain_patterns.frame_link_prompt: Smooth cinematic continuity from {frame_A_description} to {frame_B_description}, maintaining consistent lighting temperature and character position across cut
Continuous escalating action from ground-level chaos through impact to overhead aftermath, maintaining spatial geography across cuts
Progressive forensic discovery from spatial approach through evidence detail to emotional reaction, closing on contemplative environmental pause

shot_class_validation.MACRO_PROP: ffprobe verify: subject fills >=60% of frame area, no face detected in center 50% crop
shot_class_validation.OTS_DIRTY: verify foreground blur occupies 25-35% of frame edge, background subject in sharp focus
shot_class_validation.GROUND_MUD: verify camera height perspective: horizon line in upper 15% of frame or absent
shot_class_validation.GODS_EYE: verify: no horizon line visible, ground fills 100% of frame
shot_class_validation.REACTION_MICRO: verify: face fills >=70% of frame, eyes in upper third
shot_class_validation.ENV_SENSORY: verify: no human figure detected anywhere in frame

quality_gates.coverage_audit_per_video: Before render, run coverage audit: count instances of each class code. Reject any video spec where MACRO_PROP < 2 or ENV_SENSORY < 1 or (OTS_DIRTY + GROUND_MUD + GODS_EYE) < 2.
